frog-stand-1.png: Full hold: the feet are off the floor and the toes pointed together behind the hips, the knees resting on the backs of the bent elbows. The elbows are bent at about 90 degrees angled out, the torso tilted forward, the back rounded and the head lifted looking forward.
elbow-lever-1.png: Full hold: the body is horizontal and straight, supported on the hands with the elbows bent at about 90 degrees and set into the hips. Legs together and straight, extended behind, the feet are off the floor and the head is lifted looking forward with the torso level.
planche-lean-1.png: Push-up plank position facing right with the hands on the floor under the shoulders, the fingers pointing forward or slightly outward. Arms straight, the body in a straight line from head to heels, the feet together on the toes.
advanced-tuck-planche-1.png: Full hold: the arms are locked straight, the shoulders far ahead of the hands, and the back is flat and horizontal. The hips are open so that the thighs are in line with the back, the knees bent at about 90 degrees with the shins pointing straight back, feet off the floor.
tuck-planche-1.png: Full hold: the arms are locked straight and the shoulders are pushed forward past the hands. The knees are tucked tight to the chest with the hips bent, the back is rounded slightly, the hips level with the shoulders and the feet are off the floor.
one-leg-planche-1.png: Switch legs: near knee tucks under torso and far leg extends behind, maintaining forward shoulder lean.
straddle-planche-1.png: Full straddle planche hold with straight arms and shoulders ahead of wrists.
full-planche-1.png: Full hold: the body is one straight horizontal line from the head to the pointed toes, a hand-length above the floor, supported only on the hands. The arms are locked straight, the shoulders are protracted, the legs are together and straight and the hips are level.
planche-push-up-1.png: Lowering midway: the body stays in the horizontal straight line as the elbows bend to about 90 degrees and tuck beside the ribs. The torso descends toward the floor and the shoulders stay forward of the hands.
front-row-hold-1.png: Pulling up: the elbows bend and travel back as the chest rises toward the bar. The body stays a rigid straight plank from the heels to the shoulders, the heels dig into the floor and the head stays in line with the spine.
skin-the-cat-1.png: Mid rotation: the body inverted beneath the bar, the hips above the head level with the bar and the legs passing between the arms. The shoulders are rotating behind the body and the arms are straight, the back arching slightly as the legs pass over.
tuck-back-lever-1.png: Lowering back: the arms stay straight as the tucked body rotates down behind the bar into a face-down position, hips and knees tucked in, the shoulders moving into extension. Keep the faceless head neutral and aligned with the spine, and show every joint angle of the Tuck Back Lever clearly in this side (facing left) view.
advanced-tuck-back-lever-1.png: Full advanced tuck back lever: flat horizontal back, shoulders and hips level, torso facing the floor. Hips bent around 90 degrees with thighs descending below pelvis; knees bent around 90 degrees with shins extending behind. Straight arms extend behind the torso to the bar. Neutral neck and head.
advanced-tuck-front-lever-1.png: Full hold: the torso is flat and horizontal with the arms straight and vertical. The hips are open so the thighs are in line with the back, the knees bent at 90 degrees with the shins pointing down. The knees are not tight to the chest, but the back stays flat, the shoulders pressed down.
crow-pose-1.png: Full hold: both feet off the floor, toes pointed and touching together behind the hips, shins resting on the backs of the upper arms. Arms straight or almost straight, back rounded and hips high, head lifted and looking ahead, shoulders forward of the wrists.
one-leg-back-lever-1.png: Full hold: the torso is flat and horizontal facing the floor, the arms straight beside the ears behind the bar. One leg is fully extended straight back in line with the torso, the other knee is tucked tight to the chest. The hips are level, the head neutral and the shoulders in extension.
tuck-front-lever-1.png: Full hold: the torso flat and horizontal with the chest facing up, the arms straight and vertical to the bar. The knees tucked tight to the chest with the hips bent around 90 degrees and the thighs close to the torso, the head neutral, shoulders pushed down and the back flat.
one-leg-front-lever-1.png: Full hold: the torso is flat and horizontal with the chest facing up with the arms straight and vertical. One leg is fully extended straight back in line with the body, the other knee is tucked tight to the chest with the foot near the hip. The hips are level, the head neutral and the shoulders pressed down.
straddle-back-lever-1.png: Full hold: the torso is flat and horizontal, facing the floor, the arms straight and held behind the body in line with the shoulders. Both legs are straight and spread wide in a straddle of about 60 to 90 degrees, toes pointed, hips level and the head neutral.
straddle-front-lever-1.png: Full hold: the torso is flat and horizontal with the chest facing up, the arms straight and vertical to the bar. Both legs are straight and spread wide in a straddle, around 60 to 90 degrees apart, with toes pointed, the hips level with the shoulders, the head neutral.
back-lever-1.png: Full hold: the whole body in one straight horizontal line, facing the floor, from the head to the pointed toes. The arms are straight and the legs together, the shoulders in extension, the hips level with the shoulders and the head neutral.
front-lever-1.png: Full front lever: straight horizontal body with CHEST FACING UP, head right, feet left, two straight arms reaching up to bar. Hips and shoulders level, legs together.
one-arm-front-lever-1.png: Full one-arm front lever: rigid straight horizontal body, chest facing UP, head right, feet left; one straight arm reaches vertically up to bar, other arm held beside torso.
wall-handstand-1.png: Full hold chest-to-wall: arms straight vertical, shoulders open and pushed up by the ears, the body in one straight line from hands to pointed toes, only the toes touching the wall. Hands about 20 cm from the wall, head neutral looking between the hands.
pike-press-1.png: Bottom: the crown of the head just above or touching the floor, elbows deeply bent and flared, hips still stacked directly over the hands in the inverted V. Feet on the floor, legs nearly straight, torso almost vertical. Press arms fully straight to return to the top.
freestanding-handstand-1.png: Full hold: the body in one vertical line stacked hands, shoulders, hips and pointed toes. Arms locked straight, shoulders open and pushed up by the ears, legs together and straight, gentle pressure through the fingertips, head neutral between the arms.
handstand-walk-1.png: Landing the step: the right hand placed down about a hand-length ahead on the floor, both arms straight and shoulders open again. The legs return together into the vertical line, hips stacked over the hands, the body slightly advanced and toes pointed.
wall-hspu-negative-1.png: Bottom: head lowered so the crown touches the floor in front of the hands, forming a tripod with the hands, elbows bent past 90 degrees. Body still straight and vertical chest toward the wall, toes on the wall, feet together and pointed.
crow-to-handstand-1.png: Pressing up: the hips rise above the shoulders as the legs begin to extend upward behind the body. Arms stay straight and locked, the shoulders pushed forward over the hands, knees only partly straightened, toes pointing down toward the floor behind.
90-degree-push-up-1.png: Bottom position: the elbows bent to 90 degrees and held tight in against the ribs, the upper arms parallel to the floor. The shoulders are lowered to the hands' level with the torso tilted forward and the legs raised overhead, the body in a straight diagonal line.
one-arm-handstand-1.png: Full hold on the right hand only: the right arm straight and vertical, the shoulder open, the body in a straight line above it with the feet pointing up, legs slightly apart for balance. The left arm is held out to the side or beside the thigh, head neutral.
straddle-press-to-handstand-1.png: Pressing up: the shoulders move forward over the wrists, arms locked, and the straight legs lift off the floor in a straddle, rising to horizontal. The hips are raised above the shoulders, the toes pointed and the legs wide apart.
ring-support-hold-1.png: Full hold: arms locked straight with the rings held beside the hips, palms facing in toward the body. The shoulders are pressed down away from the ears, the chest tall, the legs straight and together hanging with the feet off the floor, the head neutral.
rto-support-hold-1.png: Full hold: arms locked straight with the rings turned fully out, palms facing forward and the thumbs pointing out and away from the body. The rings are beside the hips, the chest tall, the shoulders pressed down, the legs together and the feet off the floor.
ring-row-1.png: Top position: the chest is touching the rings at the ribs, the elbows are bent behind the torso and the shoulder blades are squeezed together. The body is a straight line from the heels to the head, the head neutral, the feet on the floor.
ring-dip-1.png: Gymnastics exercise demonstration: adult athlete on two gymnastics rings, at bottom of a dip repetition, both hands firmly grasp rings beside lower ribs, elbows bend 90 degrees behind torso. Chest faces right in three-quarter side view. Legs straight together pointing down; knees and feet fully visible. Two thin equipment straps rise directly from rings to top edge. Anatomically neutral head above shoulders. Plain sports shorts, blank oval head. Ordinary controlled gymnastics strength training.
banded-iron-cross-1.png: Front view of band-assisted gymnastic iron cross. Athlete vertical, arms fully straight horizontally in a T, hands grip two rings at shoulder height. Two ring straps run vertically upward from rings. A resistance band is stretched from the left ring DOWN under BOTH FEET and UP to the right ring in a wide U/V; feet press securely onto bottom of band. Band stays BELOW the arms and torso. Head and neck entirely clear, with no straps behind or beside head. Legs together straight, toes downward. Single full body.
ring-muscle-up-1.png: Gymnastics exercise demonstration: adult athlete at the completed upper support of ring muscle-up, shoulders above rings, elbows locked straight down, hands firmly grip rings alongside hips. Body upright, legs straight together down, toes pointed. Three-quarter side view facing right, full figure. Two thin equipment straps rise from the rings to top edge, clearly separated from body and head. Neutral head, plain sports shorts, blank oval head. Ordinary controlled gymnastics strength training.
iron-cross-1.png: Full hold: the arms are fully horizontal and straight, spread to both sides at shoulder height in a T shape, holding the rings. The body is vertical and straight between the rings, the legs together with the toes pointed, the head neutral and the chest tall.
kip-up-1.png: Mid movement: the hips and legs are kicked up and over so that the legs point to the ceiling at about 45 degrees over the hips. The hands push the floor near the hips while the back is lifted onto the shoulders.
handstand-to-bridge-1.png: Bridge reached: the feet land on the floor about shoulder width apart, the arms are straight and the hands remain on the floor. The hips are pushed up high, the back is fully arched, the head hangs between the arms and the knees are slightly bent.
muscle-up-1.png: Top position: arms locked straight in support above the bar, the bar at the hip level, the chest tall and the shoulders pressed down. The legs together and straight, slightly in front, the head neutral. The faceless head stays in line with the spine, and the limb angles of the Muscle-up must read clearly from the side (facing right) view.
tuck-human-flag-1.png: Full hold: the body is horizontal and sideways from the pole, the bottom arm pushing straight and the top arm pulling, bent slightly. The knees are tucked tight to the chest, the hips are level with the hands, the head is turned toward the floor and the feet are off the floor.
human-flag-1.png: Calisthenics HUMAN FLAG sports skill shown from front. A rigid vertical exercise pole at LEFT. Both hands grip pole with wide vertical separation: top hand overhead left and lower hand below left. BOTH elbows fully straight. Shoulder girdle between hands, torso extends horizontally RIGHT from pole, hips and locked straight legs continue in one horizontal line right, feet together pointed right. Body sideways supported by arms, perpendicular to pole. Full figure and pole contained with margins. Blank oval head naturally aligned with torso. Plain shorts.
strict-muscle-up-1.png: Top position: the arms locked straight in support over the bar, the bar at the hips, the shoulders pressed down and the chest tall. The legs are together and straight, the body vertical and still. The faceless head stays in line with the spine, and the limb angles of the Strict Muscle-up must read clearly from the side (facing right) view.
inverted-muscle-up-1.png: Finish: the hands on the bar and the arms pressed straight with the body in a vertical handstand directly above the bar. The legs together and pointing up, the body straight, the shoulders open and the head between the arms.
one-arm-hang-1.png: Full hold: hanging by the right hand only, arm fully straight, the shoulder pulled down and engaged away from the ear, torso square to the front. The free left arm extends out to the side, legs together and straight, body vertical and still.
archer-pull-up-1.png: Top position: chin above the bar on the right side, the head and chest shifted over the right hand. Right elbow fully bent, left arm still straight and extended along the bar, hands still on the bar at original width, legs together straight down.
one-arm-negative-1.png: Bottom of the negative: working arm fully straight in a one-arm dead hang, shoulder packed down away from the ear, body hanging vertically and square. Free hand held out to the side, not touching the bar or the wrist. Legs together and straight.
one-arm-pull-up-1.png: Top position: chin clearly above the bar, the right elbow fully bent and tucked at the ribs, the right hand still the only contact with the bar. The free left arm is held out to the side, legs together and straight, body vertical with no kip.
parallel-bar-support-hold-1.png: Full hold: arms locked straight vertical, hands by the hips on the bars, shoulders pressed down and away from the ears, chest tall. Legs straight and together hanging in front of the body just forward of the vertical, feet off the floor, head neutral.
one-arm-negative-push-up-1.png: Bottom position: chest a fist's height off the floor, working right elbow bent past 90 degrees and tucked tight to the torso, body straight from head to heels and not twisted. Left hand still on the lower back, feet wide, head neutral looking down and slightly ahead.
one-arm-push-up-1.png: Finish at the top after pressing back up: right arm fully extended and locked, shoulder just over the hand, body straight and square from head to heels. The left hand still rests on the lower back, feet wide, no hip twist or sag.
tuck-l-sit-1.png: Full hold: the arms are locked straight and vertical, the shoulders pressed down, the hips lifted off the floor. The knees are tucked to the chest with the thighs near horizontal, the feet are off the floor, the back is upright and the head is neutral.
straddle-l-sit-1.png: Full hold: the arms are locked straight, the shoulders pressed down, the hips lifted. Both legs are straight and spread wide in a straddle, lifted to horizontal level with the hips, toes pointed, the torso upright.
toes-to-bar-1.png: Top: the toes touch the bar, the legs straight and the hips piked to about 45 degrees, the torso leaning back and the arms straight. The back is rounded and the head is neutral, the toes at the level of the hands.
v-sit-1.png: Full hold: the arms are locked straight, the shoulders pressed down. The legs are straight and raised above horizontal at about 45 degrees to the floor, forming a V with the torso, the torso leaning back, the hips lifted off the floor.
manna-1.png: Perfect side profile of a gymnast performing FULL MANNA static hold on floor. Both palms planted with fingers pointing backwards left, straight arms vertical supporting shoulders. Shoulders at left and hips at right are at SAME HEIGHT, so torso is HORIZONTAL, chest faces UP. Hips pressed FORWARD beyond hands and high at shoulder height. Straight knees locked and legs tightly folded at hip; both legs extend HORIZONTALLY LEFT above chest and head, parallel to floor, toes pointed left. Draw a compressed sideways hairpin shape: horizontal torso below, horizontal straight legs above, connected at right-side hips. Neutral head at left end of torso, chin naturally toward chest. This is the advanced full Manna gymnastics pose with torso and legs both horizontal, not a V-sit. No equipment.
deep-squat-hold-1.png: Full hold: the hips are lowered between the heels below the knees, the heels flat and the feet turned out. The chest is upright, the elbows are pressed inside the knees with the palms together in front of the chest, and the back is straight.
german-hang-1.png: Full hold: the body hangs face down behind the rings with the arms straight and the shoulders in full extension behind the back. The back is arched, the hips are below the rings, the legs hang down and the head is neutral.
wrist-prep-1.png: Rocking back: the hips shift back toward the heels and the hands turn so the fingers point back toward the knees. The palms stay flat and the arms stay straight, the wrists stretched in the opposite direction.
bridge-1.png: Full hold: the arms are straight and the legs nearly straight, the feet flat on the floor. The hips are pushed high with the back evenly arched, the head hangs between the arms, the shoulders open and the chest pushed over the hands.
half-split-1.png: Full hold: the right leg is straight in front with the toes pulled back, the left knee is bent under the hips. The torso is folded forward over the right leg with the chest toward the knee, the hands on the floor beside the leg, the hips square.
front-split-1.png: Full hold: the hips on the floor, the front right leg straight forward along the floor and the back left leg straight behind with the top of the foot down. The torso is upright and tall with the arms raised overhead and the hips square to the front.
pancake-1.png: Full hold: the legs are straight and spread wide, the knees and toes facing up. The torso is folded forward from the hips with the chest close to the floor, the arms extended forward along the floor and the back long.
